scope: Dvorak Symphony No. 8, Trombone III, movement IV, original PDF page 13 systems 1-12

staff_gate.main_key_signature: one sharp (F#), inherited at page start and printed at later systems
staff_gate.cue_clef: TREBLE for the printed Vl. I. cue; all cue heads excluded

method: Visually inspected every p13 system of the original 3800x5000 scan at original pixels, enlarging accidentals and ambiguous heads. Matched candidate IDs and note heights to sloping bass staff lines, distinguished the Vl. I. treble cue and trombone rests, and located unrecognized printed heads. Source PDF and scan are unchanged.
